title: The Companies Act, 2013
source_publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice (India Code)
provision_text: ( _85_ ) "small company" means a company, other than a public company,— ( _i_ ) paid-up share capital of which does not exceed fifty lakh rupees or such higher amount as may be prescribed which shall not be more than[1] [ten crore rupees]
